notes.title: Animperium Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Animperium is available in Early Access from today! Grab your friends and jump into the action!

We have been working towards this moment for weeks and are therefore even more pleased that we have finally reached this milestone!

But this is not the end of development, it's just the beginning! You can look forward to a multitude of updates, improvements and fixes! And as always: don't hesitate to give us feedback, we look forward to it!

Have fun playing!
